ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark grey/black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast dark pigmentation concentrated along the leading edges and trailing edge perimeters. Interior surface features extensive vertical/diagonal dark streaks and two distinct circular focal points in the left-inner lobe quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex; estimated depth is approximately 12-15% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks/valleys). Right lobe trailing edge exhibits lower visible serration frequency due to camera angle and foreshortening.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct concave parabolic curve along the trailing edges transitioning to sharp upward-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast, elevated white/beige circular objects located at the distal tips of both lobes. Several smaller circular depigmented points distributed across the lower-central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral pigmentation, primarily oriented vertically.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcified barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both lobes causing irregular geometric deformation of the fluke's silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: Pair of concentric dark circular patterns with central focal dots (ocelli) located on the lower-mid quadrant of the left lobe.
